parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: Product
parameters.description: The name of the cloud product.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the VPC belongs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the VPC.

> You can call the [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) operation to query the details of VPCs.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The ID of the zone.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query zones.
